title: bellis rotundifolia proles pumila
intro: Bellis rotundifolia proles pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Daisy or Small-leaved Daisy, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, improve skin health, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Bellis rotundifolia proles pumila include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory activities, which make it useful for treating minor cuts and wounds, as well as skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide a range of health benefits.
